title: Glowing planet with rings
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='planetGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8be9ff'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#2ea8e0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1660a8'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ringGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='100%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe680'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffb84d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff8c3a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- back half of ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='44' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='url(#ringGrad)' stroke-width='5' opacity='0.55' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='34' ry='9' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2.5' opacity='0.45' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)'/>

  <!-- planet body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='26' fill='url(#planetGrad)'/>
  <!-- lighter edge highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='26' fill='none' stroke='#b8f4ff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- cloud bands -->
  <path d='M28 44 Q50 36 72 44' fill='none' stroke='#d6f7ff' stroke-width='3' opacity='0.65' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M26 54 Q50 48 74 54' fill='none' stroke='#a8ecff' stroke-width='2.5' opacity='0.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 63 Q50 58 70 63' fill='none' stroke='#d6f7ff' stroke-width='2.5' opacity='0.55' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- glow spot -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='42' r='6' fill='#e8fdff' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- front half of ring -->
  <path d='M6 52 Q50 74 94 52' fill='none' stroke='url(#ringGrad)' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)'/>
  <path d='M16 52 Q50 68 84 52' fill='none' stroke='#ffe0a0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)'/>

  <!-- little sparkle stars -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='22' r='1.8' fill='#bff6ff'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='26' r='2' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='80' r='1.6' fill='#bff6ff'/>
</svg>
